item.title: Historic Glasgow property in limbo after missing tornado funding deadline
item.description:
After missing the deadline to apply for federal disaster relief, small business owner Scott Morris is in limbo on how to get a damaged historic property he purchased in Glasgow fixed.

Morris was just 22 days away from moving into the downtown building at the corner of Market and 2nd Streets, combining his next-door business -- River Brew Coffee Company -- and a nearby bookstore -- Fitz's SideQuests. But those plans have been on hold since an EF-2 tornado tore through the roof of the building on Apr. 27.
